# Toolando.tech

> Browser-based file tools with privacy-first converters and test-based guides.

Toolando helps people convert, inspect and prepare files without installing software.
Primary indexed locales: pl, en. Other locales are available in the UI but not advertised to search engines.

## Main entry points

- Home (PL): https://www.toolando.tech/pl
- Home (EN): https://www.toolando.tech/en
- File Assistant: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/otworz
- Repair files: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools/naprawa-plikow
- Photos/scans to PDF: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools/zdjecia-do-pdf
- OCR scan → text: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools/ocr-skanu
- PDF signature/stamp: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools/podpis-pdf
- Prepare for email: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools/przygotuj-do-maila
- Compare documents: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools/porownaj-dokumenty
- All tools: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools
- Guides: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/poradniki
- Privacy inspector: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools/inspektor-prywatnosci
- HEIC → JPG: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools/heic-to-jpg
- Remove EXIF: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools/usun-exif
- Compress PDF: https://www.toolando.tech/pl/tools/kompresja-pdf
